\begin{exercise} \end{exercise}

7-6. Suppose $G$ is a Lie group and $U$ is any neighborhood of the identity. Show that there exists a neighborhood $V$ of the identity such that $V \subseteq U$ and $g{h}^{-1} \in U$ whenever $g, h \in V$ . (Used on pp. 159,556.) \end{exercise}
